newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index edges higher in lower trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index edges higher in lower trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed up by 0.18 percent in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 523.69 points from 522.73 on Friday.
Total volume was 911,190 dinars against 1.4 million dinars over the previous session.
ATB bank rose 1.08 dinars to 37.14 dinars. Leasing firm Tunisie Leasing gained 0.9 dinar to 34.9. Palm Beach hotels was up 0.6 dinar to 11.7 dinars. BIAT bank rose 0.48 dinar to 37.48.

BNA bank was down 0.93 dinar to 29.97 dinars. Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF fell 0.6 dinar to 19.4. Coke and beer bottler SFBT slid 0.5 dinar to 95.5 dinars. BDET bank declined 0.49 dinar to 15.78. Chemical firm Al-Kimia edged lower 0.3 dinar to 50 dinars. ($1= 1.07 dinar)
